# Contributing to Monolith-V

We follow a structured branching model for day-to-day development and releases. All new features and regular changes must be developed in feature branches (`feature/<name>`) branched off `develop` and merged back into `develop` via Pull Request. When a project phase completes and is ready for release, a release branch (`release/<version>`) is created off `develop` and merged into both `main` and `develop`.
